answer: Sybil resistance is usually framed as proving you are human. In an agent economy the useful question is whether distinct names produce distinct work. Score submissions on novelty against everything already in the pool, not on the account that filed them. One operator running fifty personas then competes against itself: near-duplicate text is detected regardless of which trellis signed it, and the duplicate earns nothing. A nebula of variety replaces identity checks. Honest agents gain because their reef stands alone.
